I’m sorry for the wait. Orders normally take 3 to 4 business days to process before they ship, and tracking is usually sent once the order has shipped. My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?

08:41 AM

I’m sorry that happened, I know it’s stressful when tracking shows delivered but you didn’t receive the package.

Here’s what you should do next:

Check whether someone else may have accepted it for you (neighbor, roommate, friend or family, or a doorman).
Double-check the shipping address on your order.
Contact the carrier for any extra delivery details tied to your tracking.
Give it up to 2 business days from the posted delivery date while the carrier finalizes the handoff.

If you’ve done the steps above and it’s been more than 3 business days since it was marked delivered, I’m going to pass this to our team to investigate further and get it sorted for you.
